APPROVE
The extracted `NestRoute` carries over the whole loop body unchanged. `k` advances the same way on both the skip and match paths, and the reordered `classGuard ||` check has no side effects to disturb. The remaining loop is a single null check, which plausibly brings `Nest` under 15, and the code should compile, assuming `Judged` is a reference type (if it is a struct, `yield return judged` won't build). I couldn't read the repository, so this is from the diff alone and I did not build it or measure the complexity.
